## Final prompt set

### material-archive-hero.png
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: engineering materials website hero. Primary request: a meticulously arranged materials selection archive showing polymer plaques, machined metal coupons, ceramic discs, mesh samples and precision calipers. Scene/backdrop: large warm off-white laboratory worktable with subtle grid paper and blank specimen cards. Subject: diverse engineering material samples arranged as an evidence-driven selection workspace. Style/medium: highly photorealistic editorial materials-science photography. Composition/framing: wide landscape overhead view with an asymmetric modular arrangement and generous negative space between sample groups. Lighting/mood: soft north-window laboratory light, calm, precise and premium. Color palette: warm bone white, deep navy, silver, amber polymer, ceramic white and restrained coral accents. Materials/textures: brushed alloy, matte polymer, technical ceramic, woven composite, paper and steel calipers. Constraints: physically plausible specimens, blank cards without readable text, no logos, no watermark. Avoid: generic office flat lay, excessive laboratory glassware, neon, holograms, clutter.

### performance-polymers.png
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: high-performance polymer material-family image. Primary request: premium technical still life of amber and matte-black engineering polymer rods, pellets, molded plaques and one precisely machined component. Scene/backdrop: warm off-white materials laboratory surface with a subtle measurement grid. Subject: cohesive group of physically plausible high-performance polymer forms. Style/medium: highly photorealistic industrial material photography. Composition/framing: landscape close three-quarter view, specimens organized by form with open space around them. Lighting/mood: soft directional lab lighting revealing edges and surface finish. Color palette: amber, charcoal black, warm ivory and restrained coral marker. Materials/textures: semi-translucent amber polymer, matte black polymer, clean machined surfaces. Constraints: no text, no logos, no watermark, no plastic consumer objects. Avoid: glossy toy appearance, liquid resin, impossible transparency, clutter.

### lightweight-alloys.png
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: lightweight alloy material-family image. Primary request: premium technical still life of brushed lightweight alloy coupons, a thin extrusion section, machined lattice sample and tensile-test specimen. Scene/backdrop: warm off-white materials lab table with understated navy measurement marks. Subject: physically plausible silver alloy specimens showing varied processes and finishes. Style/medium: highly photorealistic industrial material photography. Composition/framing: wide landscape oblique view with clean specimen separation and one coral inspection marker. Lighting/mood: precise softbox lighting with controlled highlights and natural shadows. Color palette: brushed silver, cool gray, deep navy, warm ivory and restrained coral. Materials/textures: bead-blasted alloy, brushed metal, machined edges and subtle oxidation-free finish. Constraints: no readable text, no logos, no watermark. Avoid: chrome luxury styling, automotive branding, sparks, factory clutter.

### technical-ceramics.png
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: technical ceramic material-family image. Primary request: premium technical still life of white and charcoal technical ceramic discs, wear tiles, a small bearing ring and fracture-test coupons. Scene/backdrop: warm off-white materials lab surface with a dark navy sample tray. Subject: a credible family of dense technical ceramic specimens. Style/medium: highly photorealistic materials-science product photography. Composition/framing: landscape macro three-quarter view emphasizing geometry, edges and material contrast. Lighting/mood: soft controlled laboratory light, precise and tactile. Color palette: ceramic white, graphite charcoal, warm ivory, deep navy and one restrained coral accent. Materials/textures: fine matte ceramic, polished wear face, subtle sintered grain. Constraints: no text, no logos, no watermark, specimens must look engineered rather than decorative. Avoid: pottery, tableware, gemstones, glossy marble, futuristic glow.

### materials-testing-lab.png
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: materials testing and technical support image. Primary request: materials engineer safely preparing a tensile specimen in a universal testing machine while reviewing a sample record. Scene/backdrop: clean real-world materials testing laboratory with tensile frame, guarded test area and organized specimen bench. Subject: one engineer in practical lab workwear, hands naturally positioning the specimen; identity not emphasized. Style/medium: photorealistic candid industrial editorial photography. Composition/framing: landscape medium-wide view showing engineer, test machine, specimen and work area. Lighting/mood: neutral laboratory lighting, quiet concentration and credibility. Color palette: warm off-white, deep navy, brushed steel and restrained coral accents. Materials/textures: real workwear, steel test frame, machined specimen and paper record. Constraints: safe posture, eye protection, no readable screen text, no logos, no watermark. Avoid: dramatic sparks, chemistry glassware, hard-hat stock photo, staged handshake.

### social-preview.png
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: social preview card for a fictional engineering materials supplier. Primary request: premium landscape social card featuring an overhead archive of polymer, alloy and ceramic engineering samples organized like a material evidence map. Scene/backdrop: warm bone-white paper field with deep navy grid lines and restrained coral selection marks. Subject: photorealistic material specimens integrated with bold editorial typography. Style/medium: sophisticated materials-science campaign design, tactile and highly legible. Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, modular specimen field on the right and typography safely inside the left margins. Lighting/mood: clean laboratory daylight, precise and confident. Color palette: warm bone, deep navy, coral orange, brushed silver, amber and ceramic white. Text (verbatim): “MATERA MATERIALS” and “Choose by evidence. Not instinct.” Constraints: render both text lines exactly once; no other text; no logos or trademarks; no watermark. Avoid: dark technology aesthetic, neon, generic stock lab, excessive small labels, clutter.

## Demo boundary

The assets illustrate fictional materials and testing contexts only. They are not evidence of real grades, supply, facilities, testing, certification, laboratory accreditation or application suitability.
